Russian

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

на- (na-) +‎ сы́пать (sýpatʹ)

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [nɐˈsɨpətʲ]

Verb

[edit]

насы́пать • (nasýpatʹ) pf (imperfective сы́пать or насыпа́ть) (the impf./pf. forms differ in word stress in the infinitive and have different conjugations)

  1. to strew, to pour (to distribute objects or pieces of something, of friable objects, not liquids)
  2. to sputter, to pelt, to spout

Etymology 2

[edit]

насы́пать (nasýpatʹ) +‎ -а́ть (-átʹ)

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [nəsɨˈpatʲ]

Verb

[edit]

насыпа́ть • (nasypátʹ) impf (perfective насы́пать) (the impf./pf. forms differ in word stress in the infinitive and have different conjugations)

  1. to strew, to pour (to distribute objects or pieces of something, of friable objects, not liquids)
  2. to sputter, to pelt, to spout
